skill.core.artillery.description.advance:
{Advanced Artillery}

Gives the hero control of the {Ballista}. The {Ballista} {shoots twice per round}, and its shots have a {75%} chance to deal double damage.

With {Archery}, {Ballista} and {Cannon} can receive matching {Archery} bonuses based on both skill levels.

Additionally, {Ballista} and its {Ammo Cart} cannot lose more than {40%} of their Health from a single attack; {Cannon} and its {Ammo Cart} cannot lose more than {30%}.
skill.core.artillery.description.basic:
{Basic Artillery}

Gives the hero control of the {Ballista}. {Ballista} shots have a {50%} chance to deal double damage.

With {Archery}, {Ballista} and {Cannon} can receive matching {Archery} bonuses based on both skill levels.

Additionally, {Ballista} and its {Ammo Cart} cannot lose more than {50%} of their Health from a single attack; {Cannon} and its {Ammo Cart} cannot lose more than {40%}.
skill.core.artillery.description.expert:
{Expert Artillery}

Gives the hero control of the {Ballista}. The {Ballista} {shoots twice per round}, and its shots {always deal double damage}.

With {Archery}, {Ballista} and {Cannon} can receive matching {Archery} bonuses based on both skill levels.

Additionally, {Ballista} and its {Ammo Cart} cannot lose more than {30%} of their Health from a single attack; {Cannon} and its {Ammo Cart} cannot lose more than {20%}.
